description: This file defines the SugarFeedDashlet class, a customized dashboard component for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It manages displaying, configuring, and interacting with social feed content within the CRM, including fetching external API updates, rendering feed items, handling user posts, and managing permissions.

classes.name: SugarFeedDashlet
classes.description: A dashboard widget class for displaying and managing social media feed streams within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dashlet settings, categories, external APIs, and user permissions.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Fetches and prepares feed data for display, including external API updates, security filtering, and sorting.

methods.name: deleteUserFeed
methods.description: Deletes a user feed entry if the user has appropriate permissions.

methods.name: pushUserFeed
methods.description: Creates a new user feed entry with provided text and link data.

methods.name: pushUserFeedReply
methods.description: Posts a reply to an existing feed entry.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Renders the configuration options interface for the dashlet.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves user-configured options for the dashlet, such as title, categories, and refresh rate.

methods.name: sugarFeedDisplayScript
methods.description: Provides JavaScript to enable dynamic feed updating.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Returns JavaScript for rendering the dashlet with proper client-side behavior.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the complete HTML for the dashlet display, including feed items, links, and formatting.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header HTML for the dashlet, including post form and warnings.

methods.name: getDisabledWarning
methods.description: Creates a warning message if the Sugar Feed system is disabled.

methods.name: getPostForm
methods.description: Generates the HTML form for users to post new feed messages.

methods.name: shouldDisplay
methods.description: Static method to determine if the Dashlet should be available; checks global settings.

methods.name: check_enabled
methods.description: Checks if specific modules like 'twitter' or 'facebook' are enabled in system configuration.
